what_happened: Dispatch's ALREADY-LANDED section described only R6 (list-item anchor) and R7 (keyword denylist) as landed-uncommitted (16 passed). Research against the live source store found a third repair, R8 (preamble-exclusion for non-keyword backticked tokens before the first Goals bullet), already landed uncommitted too (17 passed), plus the Goals extractor rewritten from shell grep -oP to Python (so defect (b)'s 4th site is now Python, not shell). The deployed .claude/ copy was also found byte-identical to the uncommitted source-store script/test files already (not stale as the dispatch's deploy-freshness note implied for this script specifically), missing only the new plan_goals_preamble.md fixture, which is why the deployed suite showed 16/1/0 instead of 17/0/0. Verified empirically rather than assumed.

All three defects were independently reproduced live against the current source-store script with throwaway scratchpad fixtures (not reconstructed from the dispatch's prose alone): (a) an abbrev and an anonymous instance between two theorems are both silently deleted from the assembled Challenge module; (b) a non-ASCII-suffixed identifier (foo₁) either escapes the Goals backtick harvest entirely (TOKEN_RE requires the ASCII run to be immediately followed by a closing backtick) or, on the declaration-header side, is TRUNCATED to foo and silently collides with cross-validation, producing theorem_names: foo for an actual theorem foo₁ declaration with exit 0; (c) the dispatch's exact MEASURED RESIDUAL sentence (comm/Nu/witness/EUFix/true) still exits 71 naming EUFix, Nu, true, witness as spurious, confirming the non-keyword in-bullet case remains unrepaired by the already-landed R8 preamble fix.

Research report recommendation 3's concrete form (harvest only the first backticked token after a bullet's leading '- ') would DROP genuine Goals in two existing green fixtures (plan_r1.md and plan_keyword_noise.md both place the identifier mid-sentence: '- Prove `comm` for natural number addition.'), so the plan adopts an identifier-leading-bullet rule WITH explicit fixture migration rather than the report's drop-in form. Separately, the report's claim that 'a redeploy resolves [the missing plan_goals_preamble.md fixture] automatically' is incorrect: lean/manifest.json's provides.scripts enumerates every challenge fixture individually and does not list plan_goals_preamble.md (grep count 0), so manifest.json must be edited or the deployed suite keeps failing R8. manifest.json was added to the plan's declared scope as a result.

suite_selection_select returned __FULL_SWEEP__ for every lean-extension script path, which made the Tier Justification honesty requirement easy to satisfy correctly: no mapped suite exists, so each phase names the dedicated test-lean-challenge-snapshot.sh suite directly rather than claiming a suite-selection subset that does not cover the file.

Source-store repo (~/.config/nvim) carries unrelated uncommitted modifications to agent-system/extensions/lean/context/project/lean4/domain/ladder-counter-observables.md and agent-system/extensions/lean/index-entries.json at Phase 1 start, apparently from a concurrent writer in that shared repo's own task space (not this dispatch's work). Scoped this dispatch's commits to exactly the 4 paths this phase's file_scope names and left the two foreign files untouched.

Phase 4's Scope Hypothesis predicted exactly 2 fixtures needed migration to the identifier-leading Goals shape. Re-extracting every fixture's Goals block before migrating found 10 total (the originally-named plan_r1.md and plan_keyword_noise.md, plus plan_legacy.md, plan_list_item_goals.md, plan_mismatched.md, plan_mixed_case.md, plan_r9_unicode.md, plan_r10_truncation.md, plan_r11_abbrev_between.md, plan_r12_anon_instance.md). The phase's own Scope Hypothesis anticipated this possibility explicitly ('treat any third mid-sentence fixture as in scope') so this was handled in-phase without a blocker; all were migrated and the suite stayed green throughout.

At Phase 4 commit time, the source store (~/.config/nvim) carries additional unrelated uncommitted/untracked paths beyond the two observed in Phase 1: agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json, agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lake-build-guard.sh (modified), and agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/gate-cost-model.csv (untracked). None are in this record's file_scope; none were staged or touched. Commit scoped to exactly the 14 paths this phase's own edits touch via explicit git add pathspecs.

Phase 5's Scope Hypothesis anticipated the possibility that a real Lean toolchain would be reachable on the implementing host and instructed asserting both the stubbed and real paths in that case. A real toolchain (elan-managed lean/lake) was indeed found, so an additional R15-REAL case (success + failure sub-cases against the real compiler) was added beyond the plan-named R15/R16/R17, guarded to skip automatically on a host without one. Caught a design issue along the way: Lean 4's autoImplicit silently auto-binds an unbound bare identifier in a theorem signature, so the first attempt at a 'broken signature' fixture compiled successfully; switched to an unbound identifier in function-application position, which autoImplicit cannot rescue, producing a genuine compile failure.

Phase 6 redeploy completed with RESULT=landed_verify_clean; the deployed lean-challenge-snapshot.sh and its suite are byte-identical to the source store, the deployed fixtures directory now holds the same fixture set as the source store (closing the manifest-registration gap R8's deployed-copy failure was a symptom of), and the deployed suite reports 29 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
